title: leiotulus involucratus

Leiotulus involucratus is valued for its medicinal properties and is often used to treat various health issues, particularly those related to the respiratory and digestive systems. The bioactive constituents of Leiotulus involucratus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
